payload.reason: The evidence discusses various aspects of active learning, including stopping methods and batch sizes, which are evaluated in the context of text classification tasks.

claims.text: The downstream tasks evaluated include text classification using active learning methods.
Different batch sizes corresponding to 1%, 5%, and 10% of the training data were considered in the experiments.
Stopping methods for active learning, such as the Oracle Method and BV2009, are evaluated based on their performance in determining when to stop the annotation process.
